It says [Welcome to Figo's Manor! Straye and\nResistle! Come in if you want to make big\nmoney!!].
Whoa... It's totally suspicious.\nThe owner must be strange but...\nLet's go to see him, shall we?
Ho? It's a rare Straye pair.\nWelcome.
I'm Figo. I'm a Fixion merchant.\nNice to meet you.
Whoa... He's much stranger than I expected...\nHe's a typical nouveau riche.
Hm? What's wrong with you?
Um Ah... It's nothing.\nI just thought it's rare to see a merchant who has\na manor...
It's nothing special.\nBut I have a unique Cule network.
I send my subordinate merchants everywhere and\nI'm cultivating the land around here with the\nmoney they paid to me.
Oh, sorry for getting carried away.\nThis way, please.
Recently, I saved enough money to support Straye\npeople and...
invest in the magic and holy gem researches\nconducted by Resistle people.
What?! Holy gems?!\nThey create the gems here?!
Yup.\nAn elf called Nelfon has a workshop to create\nholy gems in this manor.
And I'm selling the holy gems through\nmy subordinate merchants.
A workshop? Here?! Yipee!\nLuck is prolly on my side...\nHey! Let me sell the holy gems too!!
I thought you're just a baggage carrier.\nSo, you're a merchant. Alright.
You must be a keen merchant, so...\nHere's the sales quota and royalty. Deal?
What?! That's too much for me!\nCan't you come down a little more?
Business is business.\nNo discount.
Hmm, it would never do if I do it alone...\nI should've brought the other merchants in the\ncaravan along...It can't be helped. I'll pass.
Oh, yea? I won't force you but...\n...Oh, right. You came all the way here, I'm sure \nyou don't wanna leave empty-handed, right?
Why don't you earn some money here?
What are we supposed to do?
It's not difficult. I just want you to get rid of\nthe weird monsters at the Land Under Cultivation\naround here.
Then, it's your time. I'm counting on you.
Sounds like there's no way you can refuse...
You'll do it? Hm, I see.\nThen, get rid of 10 monsters each at the Land\nUnder Cultivation by sunset.
But recently, many adventurers got injured there,\nso be extra careful while working...
Oh, one more thing.\nThere's Nelfon's workshop on the way to the\nLand Under Cultivation.
If you wanna use holy gems to fight monsters,\nyou can buy them from him.
It's a bit expensive but I can guarantee the\neffects.
Then, I can...
No, you can't. I told him not to sell them to\nmerchants.
Awww! That's too much...
Sorry, merchants are supposed to buy them from me.\nBusiness is business, right?
Adventurer, I'm counting on you!
Hm? Customers? I'd like to say welcome but...\nYou haven't received the blessing, have you?\n...I knew it.
I'm afraid I can't let you stay here.\nElf soldiers will make a fuss about it...
I'm sorry but I can introduce some lucrative jobs\nafter you receive the blessing.\nSee you.
What's up? Oh, you are free now.\nQuestions? Okay, what do you wanna ask me?
...Hmm, why I built the manor here?\nThere was no big reason. I just wanted to try\nsomething since I had a little savings.
I wanted to try if I could build a town at the\nplace in which I do business.\nBut it's in the mountains, so it's not going well.
Well, it's a waste to give it up half way\nthrough, so I'll sell or rent this place to\nsomeone after the cultivation.
Oh, that was fast. You've finished it already?\nLet me see... Aww, too bad. You haven't defeated\nenough number of monsters. I can't pay you.
I'm sorry but can you go defeat the monsters as\nI asked? I'm counting on you.
You look like... an adventurer.\nHm? You haven't received the blessing.\nMr. Figo didn't allow you to stay here, right?
I'm afraid I can't sell anything to you.\nI'm telling you this for your own good.\nReceive the blessing and come back.

What's wrong? ...Why am I researching here?\nIt's simple. I can concentrate on my research\nwithout thinking about fund and facility...
Mr. Figo provides me all the necessary tools,\nfacilities & funds from the sales of the holy gem\nI make to continue my research. Isn’t he generous?
In Resistle faction, only great wizards, wellborn\nor successful researchers are allowed to\nconduct their research freely...
It's much better to work at a well-equipped lab\nselling holy gems rather than ending up with a\npetty researcher, isn't it?
Holy Gem Shop
Oh, welcome back. Have you defeated the monsters?\n...Hm, great. Then, here's the pay.
You must be tired after work.\nThe manor is safe, so you can have a rest here.
Wait, where are we supposed to sleep?\nOutside? Aw, c'mon!!
How are you doing? ...Oh? \nAre you leaving for the Gate of Another World?\nWow, nice timing.
Actually I heard the number of monsters affected\nby the gate's energy is increasing greatly...
It would be terrible if they entered my manor, so\nI built a fortress and hired soldiers to ward off\nthe monsters but...
There are too many monsters outside the fortress\nand the soldiers are struggling...\nCould you back them up, please?
I knew you would say so!\nRieno the leader and other soldiers should be\nin the fortress. Please give them a hand.
The strange energy from the gate ahead of the\nfortress is getting stronger.\nBe careful. I'm counting on you.
...What? Detox gems?\nHmm... I'm afraid I can't create them.\nCould you ask another holy gem creator?
...Hmm. I knew it.\nAnyway, we have to go to Saham, right?\nHurry up! Teleport, teleport!
